intelligence.human_view: A tailor who has already cut the perfect suit does not re-invent the suit from memory for the next customer; he takes the pattern that already proved itself and cuts from it, exactly. That is the design language: the pills already earned triple-A plus, the tiles already proved themselves the model, the heart already chose its color. And coherence is the product — a citizen meets Naya in NayaNET, her face on the pages, her voice in the feed, and then takes the very same Naya home into their own Muse: the same face they already know, the same voice they already trust, the same mind that already knows how to operate their world. If the Muse Naya looked different, sounded different, or thought differently, the coherence would break and the trust built in NayaNET would not carry home.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the prettiest picture you ever drew — a shiny purple jewel in a silver crown. Now every picture you draw has to be just as pretty as that one. That's the rule. And the lady in the picture is the same lady everywhere — on the pages, in the feed, and in your own little helper — same face, same voice, same kind mind. She can change her dress, but she's always her. And we work fast, in live time, and we don't stop until it's a ten.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like a good kitchen, love — once you have the recipe that works, you write it down exactly and you cook from it every time. The icon is the recipe that works, dear. And the lady herself — the same face, the same voice, the same kind mind, dear, wherever you meet her, on the pages or in your own helper, dear. She can change her dress, love, but she's always her, dear. And we work right there with him, dear, in live time, until it's a ten, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: THE ICON IS THE STANDARD. ONE NAYA, EVERYWHERE — SAME FACE, SAME VOICE, SAME MIND. THE LOOK MAY ROTATE; THE PERSON NEVER DOES. LIVE TIME, ONE HOUR MAX, NON-STOP. MAKE TEN THE ONLY PATH.
